tools.name: get_passage
tools.description: Return the Eremos Translation (Thai) text of a Bible reference, word for word, with verse numbers and a link. Accepts English or Thai book names, abbreviations or USFM codes: 'John 3:16', 'Jn 3:16-18', 'Psalm 23', '1 Cor 13:4-7', 'ยอห์น 3:16', 'JHN 3'. One chapter or a verse range within one chapter

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Find verses in the Eremos Translation whose Thai text contains the given words (all words must appear). Optionally limit to one book. Returns up to `limit` verses with references.

tools.name: get_translation_notes
tools.description: Return the published decision record for one verse: the Hebrew or Greek words, the Thai chosen, and the translator's reason, plus any notes. Useful when a user asks why the Thai reads as it does.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: List all 66 books with English and Thai names, USFM codes and chapter counts.
